errors.text_span: The outer ring, labeled “Ambiguity Std (Outer),” is divided into four segments corresponding to standard deviation values of 0.0 (darkest blue, 49.0%), 0.47 (medium-dark blue, 47.7%), 0.82 (medium-light blue, 7.0%), and 0.94 (lightest blue, 5.0%). The inner ring, labeled “Max Ambiguity (Inner),” is divided into three segments representing maximum ambiguity values of 1 (light blue, 38.0%), 2 (medium blue, 39.0%), and 3 (very light blue, 14.2%).
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly treats the chart as two separate rings, each with its own segments. The chart is a single nested donut chart with 7 distinct segments, where each segment represents a combination of one 'Ambiguity Std' category and one 'Max Ambiguity' category.

The description incorrectly maps the category 'Std: 0.47' to the value 47.7%. In the chart, the segment with the value 47.7% has a medium-light blue outer ring, which corresponds to 'Std: 0.82' according to the legend. The color for 'Std: 0.47' (medium-dark blue) corresponds to three different segments with values 5.0%, 39.0%, and 14.2%.

The description incorrectly maps the category 'Max: 1' to the value 38.0%. In the chart, the segment with the value 38.0% has a medium blue inner ring, which corresponds to 'Max: 2' according to the legend. The color for 'Max: 1' (light blue) corresponds to four different segments with values 49.0%, 47.7%, 7.0%, and 5.0%.

errors.text_span: each ring represents a separate marginal distribution rather than a nested or conditional one.
errors.evidence: This statement is a direct misinterpretation of the chart's structure. The chart visually represents a joint distribution, where each segment's value is determined by the combination of an outer ring category and an inner ring category. It does not show two separate marginal distributions.

errors.text_span: with the outer ring segments summing to 100% and the inner ring segments also summing to 100%
errors.evidence: This claim is false. The values the description erroneously assigns to the outer ring segments (49.0, 47.7, 7.0, 5.0) sum to 108.7%, not 100%. The values for the inner ring segments (38.0, 39.0, 14.2) sum to 91.2%, not 100%. The statement that they sum to 100% is hallucinated.
